spans.s: To rise, arise or spring from.

To agitate, elevate; raise oneʼs voice.
 €10 U. or Caus. (ईरयति, ईरित)

To agitate, throw, cast;
 Śi. 8. 39; discharge, dart, hurl; ऐरिरच्च महाद्रुमम्
To excite, prompt, urge; क्षेमंकरेऽर्थे मुहुरीर्यमाणः
To utter, pronounce, proclaim, say, repeat;

To cause to go, set in motion, move, shake; वातेरितपल्लवाङ्गुलिभिः
 Ś. 1; अपरागसमीरणेरितः

To draw towards, attract; उद्धतैरिव परस्परसङ्गादीरितान्युभयतः
 कुचकुम्भैः Śi. 10. 32.

To elevate. ━To raise oneself (Ā.).
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20260605. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/250.
€2 Ā. (ईर्ते^1, ईराञ्चक्रे, ऐरिष्ट, ईरितुम्, ईर्ण); also €1 P. (p. p. ईरित)
